The workflow validates. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ae_002
steps:
  - id: read_category_spreadsheet
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      source: google_drive
      file_type: spreadsheet
      file_id: "{{config.category_spreadsheet_id}}"
    output: category_spreadsheet

  - id: extract_article_title
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{trigger.extracted_article}}"
      field: title
    output: article_title

  - id: normalise_article_title
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{extract_article_title.article_title}}"
      operations:
        - strip_accents: true
        - lowercase: true
        - strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_article_title

  - id: normalise_spreadsheet_titles
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{read_category_spreadsheet.category_spreadsheet}}"
      apply:
        op: transform_json
        params:
          input: "{{item.title}}"
          operations:
            - strip_accents: true
            - lowercase: true
            - strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_spreadsheet_rows

  - id: match_category
    op: filter_records
    params:
      source: "{{normalise_spreadsheet_titles.normalised_spreadsheet_rows}}"
      condition:
        field: normalised_title
        operator: equals
        value: "{{normalise_article_title.normalised_article_title}}"
      accent_insensitive: true
      punctuation_insensitive: true
    output: matched_row

  - id: check_match_found
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      condition: "{{matched_row != null and matched_row | length > 0}}"
      on_true:
        category: "{{match_category.matched_row[0].category}}"
        section: "{{match_category.matched_row[0].section}}"
        needs_review: false
      on_false:
        category: "Ciencia economica"
        section: "Dossier"
        needs_review: true
    output: category_assignment

  - id: format_result
    op: format_output
    params:
      template:
        article_title: "{{extract_article_title.article_title}}"
        category: "{{check_match_found.category_assignment.category}}"
        section: "{{check_match_found.category_assignment.section}}"
        needs_review: "{{check_match_found.category_assignment.needs_review}}"
    output: final_result
